columnMapping.description:
Map where the key is the column name in the table being copied from and the value is the column name in
the table being copied to.  If either the old/new column doesn't exist in the relevant table, an error will
be thrown.  Any columns not represented in the map will still be copied if they exist in both the old and
new table.

batchSize.description: Number of rows to process per batch.  Must be a positive number
